builds.title: Kenku locksmith lookout, Rogue 1
traits: Leather armor +2 and Dex +3. Touch AC 13, flat-footed AC 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fort +1, Ref +5, Will +1. Improved Initiative adds +4.
Sneak Attack adds 1d6 while Kett flanks the target in melee or the target loses its Dexterity bonus to AC. For ranged attacks this requires a target within 30 ft.
Trapfinding lets Kett use Search for traps above DC 20 and Disable Device against magic traps. Carries a set of ordinary thieves’ tools.
Great Ally grants +4 total to attack a foe flanked with an ally and modifies a successful aid another to +3 when giving or receiving aid.
actions: Short sword +0 melee (+4 while flanking with an ally), 1d6 piercing, 19–20/×2. Two claws +0 melee each on a full attack, 1d3 piercing and slashing each.

Aid another in melee as a standard action. Roll +0 against AC 10 while threatening the foe. On success, give an ally +3 on their next attack against that foe or the normal +2 AC against its next attack, as chosen, before Kett’s next turn. On a skill check, successful legal aid gives +3.
Mimic a familiar voice in a language Kett knows. A listener who knows the original voice contests Kett’s Bluff +3 with Sense Motive.
builds.tactics: Assist at the lock first. In a fight, hold opposite an ally and use the flank bonus to land a sneak attack.

builds.title: Nycter cavern scout, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: 3 racial HD plus Fighter 1, LA +2, ECL 6.
traits: Leather armor +2, Dex +4 and Small +1. Touch AC 15, flat-footed AC 13. BAB +4, grapple +0. Fort +5, Ref +7, Will +5.
Alertness and Improved Initiative are racial-HD feat selections. Fighter bonus feat Weapon Finesse applies to the dagger.
With blindsense, Pell pinpoints creatures within 60 ft. without sight if he has line of effect. A creature he cannot see still has total concealment. He carries a light load.
actions: Small dagger +9 melee, 1d3 piercing or slashing, 19–20/×2.
Small light crossbow +9 ranged, 1d6 piercing, 19–20/×2, 80-ft. range increment. Reload as a move action that provokes.
Fly up to 40 ft. on a move action. Pell can hover and change heading with good maneuverability.
builds.tactics: Survey from a hover and call out concealed movement. In a fight, use ledges to break line of sight and return to cover to reload.

builds.title: Synad psionic courier, Nomad Psion 1
builds.speed: 30 ft. (45 ft. on level ground with Skate).
traits: Unarmored, Dex +2. Touch AC 12, flat-footed AC 10. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fort +1, Ref +2, Will +5 with Threefold Mind.
Alertness and Psionic Talent (psion bonus feat). Reserve 8 PP (base 2, Intelligence 1, racial 3, feat 2). Max 1 PP per manifested power. Standard power DC 14 if needed.
Oracle 1/day. Add +2 insight to one initiative check, attack, or save. The latter two may receive the bonus after the unmodified result is known.
Collective as a free action costs 1 PP. Use it to raise one of Ione’s listed Knowledge or Psicraft checks from +7 to +9.
actions: Light crossbow +2 ranged, 1d8 piercing, 19–20/×2, 80-ft. range increment. Loading is a move action that provokes.

Energy Ray (1 PP, standard action, 25 ft.). Ranged touch +2. Cold or fire 1d6+1, electricity 1d6 (+3 to hit metal armor and +2 on power-resistance checks), or sonic 1d6−1 that ignores object hardness. No save. Power resistance applies.
Force Screen (1 PP, standard action, personal) gives +4 shield AC for 1 minute, including against incorporeal touch attacks.

Skate (1 PP, standard action, personal or touch) lasts 1 minute. A willing creature gains +15 ft. enhancement to land speed, normal speed uphill and another +15 ft. downhill. An unattended object up to 100 lb. counts at one-tenth weight for dragging.

Multitask 1/day costs 1 PP for a swift purely mental action. Ione can manifest as that action only if her ordinary actions in the same round involve no manifesting. Spend the chosen power’s 1 PP separately.
builds.tactics: Spend 2 PP to manifest Skate with Multitask while using an ordinary move or full-round run. Save Oracle for a dangerous save or key attack.

builds.title: Savage Coast tortle creek guide, Fighter 1
builds.speed: 6, Sw 3 (numeric rates from the companion creature appendix).
builds.senses: Infravision 60 ft. including underwater. Hearing and smell only while fully withdrawn.
skills: Swimming (free). Direction Sense (Wis +1, target 14), Fishing (Wis −1, target 12), Rope Use (Dex, target 14).
Proficient in quarterstaff, sling, dagger, and natural claws.
traits: Dexterity 14 gives no AC modifier. Natural AC 3 while unarmored. Fighter THAC0 20 and ordinary low-roll 1d10 initiative. Mera uses the core fighter class without a kit. She lives beyond the cursed area and has no Legacy.
Saving throws 14/16/15/17/17 in this order: paralyzation, poison or death; rod, staff or wand; petrification or polymorph; breath; spell. While fully withdrawn, those numbers become 10/12/11/13/13.
Can hold her breath for 10 turns. Natural buoyancy keeps Mera afloat in water, mud, bogs, and quicksand.
actions: Quarterstaff, THAC0 20, speed factor 4. One melee attack dealing 1d6 bludgeoning against any target size.
Natural claws, THAC0 20 per claw, speed factor 2. Two attacks dealing 1d4 slashing each.

Withdraw into shell and do nothing else that round. While inside, AC becomes 1, saving throws improve by +4, and Mera cannot move, attack, or see. She is immune to gaze attacks and other attacks that require her to see.
builds.tactics: Use the staff to hold the ford edge. If pinned from several sides, withdraw until allies can break the press.

concepts.name: Kett Brassring
concepts.motive: Find the second cut of a master key before it opens the weir district storehouses.
concepts.hook: Kett can identify the duplicate by its worn shoulder and will help open the boathouse lock.

concepts.name: Pell Ventmark
concepts.role: Cavern surveyor who maps air shafts.
concepts.motive: Recover a bronze depth marker before a spring flood washes it down the sink.
concepts.hook: Pell offers to mark an upper ledge that pedestrians cannot see from the shaft floor.

concepts.name: Ione Lark
concepts.role: Psionic courier who moves messages before a route is cut off.
concepts.motive: Deliver a survey correction to the crew before they demolish the sound bridge pier.
concepts.hook: Ione has a copy of the wrong survey and needs an escort to the isolated site.

concepts.name: Mera Reedpole
concepts.speciesPublication: Savage Coast Campaign Book, Part 2: Player Characters
concepts.role: Creek guide and occasional ferry guard.
concepts.motive: Get the last load of oat sacks over the ford before the creek rises.
concepts.hook: Mera can show the party a level creek bed if someone helps recover her mooring line.
